claim.claim-text: 1. A method for manufacturing a photovoltaic module, comprising:

stacking a first substrate (171), a first encapsulating layer (161), the solar cell string (1), a second encapsulating layer (162), and a second substrate (172) to form a stacked structure; and performing a lamination treatment on the stacked structure, wherein during the lamination treatment, each of the plurality of first wires (23) is electrically connected with two adjacent solar cells (20) and comprises a solder core and an alloy layer surrounding the solder core, and wherein a process temperature used in the lamination treatment is greater than a melting point temperature of the alloy layer, and a difference between the process temperature and the melting point temperature is less than or equal to 30°C.
2. The method of claim 1, wherein laying the plurality of second wires (22) includes:

for at least one second wire (22) of the plurality of second wires (22) located at the first or the last of the plurality of solar cells (20), stretching the at least one second wire (22) to extend outside the first or the last of the plurality of solar cells (20).
3. The method of claim 1 or 2, wherein the pressing treatment comprises at least one of:

a heating treatment, wherein the first adhesive layer (21) comprises a hot melt adhesive, and the second adhesive layer (24) comprises a hot melt adhesive; and an ultraviolet irradiation treatment, wherein the first adhesive layer (21) comprises a UV curable adhesive, and the second adhesive layer (24) comprises a UV curable adhesive.
4. The method of any of claims 1 to 3, wherein a material of the alloy layer includes at least one of Sn, Pb, Bi, In, Zn, Cu, Sb, and Ag.
5. The method of any of claims 1 to 4, wherein a process pressure used in the lamination treatment is -50 kPa to 200 kPa.
6. The method of any of claims 1 to 5, wherein the melting point temperature is in a range of 100 °C to 160°C.

7. A photovoltaic module, manufactured by the method of any of claims 1 to 6 and comprising: the first substrate (171), the first encapsulating layer (161), the solar cell string (1), the second encapsulating layer (162), and the second substrate (172) that are sequentially stacked.

8. The photovoltaic module of claim 7, wherein in the first direction, an absolute value of a difference between a total length of the plurality of solar cells (20) and a length of the first adhesive layer (21) is less than or equal to 100 mm.

9. The photovoltaic module of claim 7 or 8, wherein in the first direction, an absolute value of a difference between a length of the second adhesive layer (24) and a total length of the plurality of solar cells (20) is less than or equal to 60 mm.
10. The photovoltaic module of any of claims 7 to 9, wherein the first adhesive layer (21) has a total thickness of 0.1 mm to 0.4 mm in a direction perpendicular to the first adhesive layer (21).
11. The photovoltaic module of any of claims 7 to 10, wherein the second adhesive layer (24) has a thickness of 0.1 mm to 0.4 mm in a direction perpendicular to the second adhesive layer (24).

12. The photovoltaic module of any of claims 7 to 11, wherein the first adhesive layer (21) comprises a supporting layer (212) and an adhesive layer (211), and the adhesive layer (211) is located between the supporting layer (212) and the plurality of solar cells (20).
13. The photovoltaic module of any of claims 7 to 12, wherein the second adhesive layer (24) is of a single-layer structure.
14. The photovoltaic module of any of claims 7 to 13, wherein
15. The photovoltaic module of claim 12, wherein the adhesive layer (211) has a thickness in a range of 50 µm to 300 µm, and the supporting layer (212) has a thickness in a range of 50 µm to 300 µm.
